purpose: This table cleans the bronze nycflights13 flights capture (January-June 2013, JFK/LGA/EWR departures) into a typed silver record of one row per scheduled flight departure, feeding downstream delay, on-time-performance, and route analyses.
usage: Consumers should treat dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, air_time, and tailnum as nullable and check the derived flight_departed flag (or null dep_time) before computing delay metrics, since roughly 3% of rows represent flights that never departed or arrived; all other fields are fully populated and required.
limitations: The profile covers only a six-month 2013 window with no duplicate rows detected (duplicate_row_rate 0.0), so dedupe logic is not exercised here; dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time remain nullable (2.9%-3.3% null) with no imputation, and tailnum is nullable at 0.9%, so joins to a planes table on tailnum will silently drop those rows.
